lora/llama-tiny.note: Reference calls PEFT's adapted transformer, including merged/trained logits and gradients.

lora_exports.note: Adapters Dew writes (llama-tiny fresh, rsLoRA and patterned; tiny SD, FLUX and SD3 denoisers), factors moved by seeded draws, read by PEFT's PeftModel and Diffusers' load_lora_weights with every file tensor landing; adapted and merge_and_unload/fuse_lora outputs in float32 and float64 (diffusers_wan_reference.float64); content SHA-256 of each adapter file. Torch 2.14.0+cpu. The sd case: the outputs are Diffusers' PyTorch UNet's, which differs from the Flax-declared tiny SD in its exact GELU and its attention GroupNorm epsilon (1e-6, Flax 1e-5); Dew runs that twin (test_lora.torch_unet).
